title: Offline production-readiness, upgrade, rollback, incident, and maintenance harness

failure_semantics.side_effects: No release, publication, upgrade, rollback, incident response, maintenance, provider, network, Git, CI, Coordinator, or durable-state operation is performed.

limitations: The harness validates supplied structural observations only.
A qualified fixture is not production readiness, a live upgrade or rollback, incident response, maintenance execution, provider support, or remote success.
Release and publication remain not_performed; provider execution and remote verification remain unverified.
follow_up: A separately approved revision-bound live contract is required before any host or provider operation.
